# A parameterized function that transitively calls an async native,
# when referenced from a visual prop (reactive context), is a checker error.
# The NoAsyncReactive lowering cannot key a per-call-argument settled state field.

! sngl check app.sngl
stderr 'async expression not allowed in parameterized reactive context'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"
import api "js:./api"

func greet(name string) => api.fetchHello(name)

window #main(title="Main") {
    text(value=greet("World"))
}

-- api/index.ts --
export async function fetchHello(name: string): Promise<string> { return "hi " + name; }
